# 1Password for Coding Agents

> A security-first setup guide for giving Codex, Claude Code, or Oh My Pi least-privileged access to one dedicated 1Password vault.

Use this guide to help a user configure 1Password without exposing any token or secret in chat, logs, source control, command arguments, or plaintext files.

Security rules:

- Never ask the user to paste a token or secret into the conversation.
- Use a dedicated vault; never expose the user's personal vault.
- Use a narrowly scoped service account. Default to read-only access.
- The required environment variable is `OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN`.
- Item titles use `<project>/<service>/<environment>`.
- Prefer `op run`, `op inject`, or a single `op read` at execution time.
- Treat `agent-safe` as an allow-list naming convention, not access control.
- Never print, log, summarize, or commit secret values.

Recommended workflow:

1. Inspect the project and propose its project/service/environment namespace.
2. Check for 1Password CLI 2.18.0 or later and `jq`.
3. Guide the user through creating a dedicated vault on 1Password.com.
4. Guide the user through creating a service account with access only to that vault. Explain that its access and permissions are immutable.
5. Tell the user to save the one-time token in a personal vault that the service account cannot access.
6. Have the user load the token through hidden shell input, not chat or shell history.
7. Verify with `op user get --me` without revealing the token.
8. Store secrets as API Credential items with semantic fields and namespaced titles.
9. Add a secrets policy to the project's `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or equivalent.
10. Show the exact runtime secret-reference command the project should use.

## Guide

- [Human-readable setup guide](https://pages.illustrious.dev/onepassword-agent-vault/): Full walkthrough, copyable agent prompt, and reusable AGENTS.md policy.
- [Bootstrap shell script](https://pages.illustrious.dev/onepassword-agent-vault/bootstrap-agent-vault.sh): Validates a service-account session and creates one namespaced API Credential item through hidden input.

## Primary sources

- [Create and share vaults](https://support.1password.com/create-share-vaults/): Official 1Password vault creation instructions.
- [Get started with service accounts](https://www.1password.dev/service-accounts/get-started): Official service-account permissions, token, and web wizard behavior.
- [Use service accounts with 1Password CLI](https://www.1password.dev/service-accounts/use-with-1password-cli): Official environment variable and CLI requirements.
- [Load secrets into scripts](https://www.1password.dev/cli/secrets-scripts): Official `op run`, `op read`, and `op inject` guidance.

## Optional

- [llms.txt proposal](https://llmstxt.org/): Format and path-coverage convention used by this file.
